name: lightwell
summary: Prepares the owned Lightwell CI/CD simulation with approval-gated Automation Orchestrator wiring.

lifecycle.idempotency: Reuses the owned repository, runner, AAP inventory, credentials, and workflow without resetting user branch content.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before changing CI/CD wiring when the selected Fleet node, Gitea service, AAP API, or ownership checks fail.

readiness: The selected owned Fleet node is reachable through AAP.
The reviewed workflow is imported without launching a deployment.

security.secret_storage: AAP and runner credentials are stored in the encrypted credential Vault or owned AAP credential objects.
security.network_trust: Gitea, AAP, and OpenFlake connections retain verified TLS.
security.external_actions: No production deployment occurs without the workflow approval gate.
